name: DV-3000
description: "A control amplifier developed as an advanced model of the on-life research control amplifier U-22.The left and right channels are completely separated electrically and mechanically. As a result, the conventional 40 to 50 dB crosstalk at 10 kHz is reduced to 90 dB or more at 10 kHz or less.A low-impedance CR circuit is used to minimize the RIAA deviation of the equalizer circuit.The amplifier circuit consists of a direct-coupled amplifier with DC feedback as a basic unit.A passive CR circuit is used for the tone control circuit and equalizer circuit, which eliminates the phase disturbance in the high-frequency range and the distortion caused by the normal NF type.It is compatible with both MM and MC cartridges by switching between Phono inputs.An interstage capacitor with a third harmonic distortion factor of 150 dB or less is used to reduce the low-level signal distortion factor.All components, including the equalizer, are carefully selected by a Linearity Checker of Radiometer (Denmark).Balance control is eliminated and channel separation is improved.It has a direct terminal that can be directly input to the equalizer circuit without passing through the selector.The muting switch can cut the noise when the needle goes up and down.Equipped with a peak meter.There was a special wood case sold separately."

name: DV-3000GOLD
description: "A control amplifier released as a superior model of the DV 3000.For the DV 3000 Gold, Telefunken high reliability tubes ECC 802 and ECC 803 are carefully selected and used.All the sockets and input / output terminals of the 10 vacuum tubes are gold-plated to prevent problems caused by contact resistance and increases in contact resistance caused by corrosion.The front panel uses a 20 mm thick aluminum plate and is finished with an ultra-precision solid plate.Also, all the knobs are finished with gold plating.The left and right channels are completely separated electrically and mechanically. As a result, the conventional 40 to 50 dB crosstalk at 10 kHz is reduced to 90 dB or more at 10 kHz or less.A low-impedance CR circuit is used to minimize the RIAA deviation of the equalizer circuit.In addition, the DV 3000 Gold is fully DC, which increases the stability of the low-frequency circuit and flattens the characteristics.The amplifier circuit consists of a direct-coupled amplifier with DC feedback as a basic unit.A passive CR circuit is used for the tone control circuit and equalizer circuit, which eliminates the phase disturbance in the high-frequency range and the distortion caused by the normal NF type.It is compatible with both MM and MC cartridges by switching between Phono inputs.An interstage capacitor with a third harmonic distortion factor of 150 dB or less is used to reduce the low-level signal distortion factor.All components, including the equalizer, are carefully selected by a Linearity Checker of Radiometer (Denmark).Balance control is eliminated and channel separation is improved.It has a direct terminal that can be directly input to the equalizer circuit without passing through the selector.The muting switch can cut the noise when the needle goes up and down.The VU meter and peak meter can be switched, and a dimmer switch is installed to change the brightness of the meter light.There was a special wood case sold separately."

name: DV-505
description: "A mass separation type dynamic balance tone arm employing an electromagnetic viscous mass control system.It has a unique structure with two support shafts, a main arm for lateral movement only and a sub arm for longitudinal movement only.This increases the inertia mass of the arm mass of the arm, the movement of the cartridge in the longitudinal direction is lightened, and it is easy to follow the warping and dispersion of records.This structure also provides a large margin against howling.In order to eliminate large peaks due to the low-frequency resonance of the tone arm and to further clarify the low-frequency separation, a dynamic damping system is adopted. In this system, the property of coupled vibration is utilized by installing a sub vibration system in the main arm, and the low-frequency resonance is suppressed within 2.5 dB.In order to reduce resonance in the lateral direction, we have adopted an electromagnetic viscosity control mechanism that applies resistance by eddy currents and magnetic field lines.As a result, the deterioration of oil caused by the aging of oil, which occurred in the oil dump type, is eliminated.The cartridge's needle pressure application mechanism adopts a dynamic balance type using a spiral spring.The arm base is in the free position, and the pin cord connector can be mounted horizontally from the arm mounting part.This eliminates the need for drilling the player board.There are 3 variations of blue, silver and black."
